versions.changelog: v1.1.3: --force flag for skip-auto-rule; atomic temp+rename writes; batch.json 5000-entry cap; rules clear command; --dir override; hardened CLI arg parser; --force in any position; dead addToDigest removed; SKILL.md rewritten with critical warnings section

**notification-triage v1.1.2**

- Notifications classified as "ignore" are now logged to dropped.json for audit/auditability (not just silently dropped).
- On first classification of a source, a persistent rule is auto-created and saved; rules should be reviewed regularly.
- Digest command now backs up the last digest in digest.json (max 1000 entries) for auditing; digest remains a destructive (clearing) operation.
- Updated documentation for enhanced warnings and new audit/logging behavior.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md.

- Added detailed warning section in documentation about risks of silent suppression and disk persistence.
- Clarified destructive nature of the `--digest` command; digested notifications are cleared and cannot be re-shown.
- Documented persistent data files and how to clear stored state.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.
Critical keyword detection forces URGENT, auto-rule expiry (7 days), batch cap (500), 0600 file permissions, structured rule objects. 24 tests.

Initial release: 24/24 self-tests, notification classification (regex + keyword), priority scoring (1-10), batching with dedup, configurable routing, batch save/load. Added module.exports. Zero external dependencies.
